title: On real app revisions, the best model fully finishes one task in four
friendlyTitle: The best model fully finishes about one real edit in four
summary: Co-Design Bench is 273 revision tasks taken from real coding sessions, with hidden criteria and no gold screenshot. Under one shared harness, the strongest of ten model endpoints meets about 70 percent of a task's criteria on average, and fully finishes 26.4 percent of tasks. Tasks that mix three or four kinds of change score worse for every model tested.
friendlySummary: Researchers built 273 tasks from real requests to change an existing app. The best model met about 70 percent of the checks on a typical task. It finished every check on only 26.4 percent of tasks.
whyItMatters: A high score on an older coding test can mean the agent did most of the work and left a detail. If you use a coding agent on an existing app, plan to check the result, especially when the request changes layout, behavior, and content at once.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A good score can still leave one broken detail. If you ask an agent to change an app you already have, look at the result yourself, especially when the request mixes design and behavior.
